title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
task: Evaluating whether video generators match ground-truth distributions of physical behaviors
key_results: No model consistently matches reference probabilities across 50 scenarios and 11 systems; gap remains between current video generators and probabilistically aligned world modeling
comments: PAWBench formally defines a critical gap: plausibility ≠ distributional correctness, exposing a fundamental evaluation blind spot in current video generation literature.

model_io.model: PAWEval outcome-level protocol + PAWBench scenarios

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current video generators achieve individual-video plausibility but fail probabilistic alignment across repeated rollouts

title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City

key_results: MLLM agents show atomic visual recognition and short-range reasoning but fail sustained goal-directed behavior; errors accumulate over extended exploration in Hong Kong 3D replica
comments: UrbanGround exposes a critical failure mode: local perceptual abilities do not compose into reliable long-horizon behavior, reflecting real deployment challenges.

title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
task: Test-time mathematical reasoning without ground-truth labels via policy optimization
key_results: TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five benchmarks; raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in test-time training; +25.2%–+36.4% improvement without reasoning chains
comments: Asymmetric objective elegantly handles label-noise by learning differently from agreeing vs. disagreeing rollouts; a clever self-supervised reasoning approach.

model_io.model: LLM with TTPO (asymmetric OPSD + Grouped RL + token-level selection)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Majority-vote pseudo-labels corrupt teachers and mislead tokens but this failure is asymmetric: disagreeing rollouts are typically wrong regardless of vote correctness
hypotheses.result: TTPO exploits asymmetry via separate distillation (agreeing) and RL (disagreeing) branches; matches supervised OPSD without labels

title: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher

key_results: Self-OPD outperforms RL and OPD methods without task-specific teachers on single and mixed reward benchmarks; branches K stochastic SDE candidates and compares rewards

title: A low power dynamic latch comparator with grounded reset for gigahertz analog to digital conversion in 180 nm CMOS
task: Design low-power dynamic latch comparator for GHz-range ADC
key_results: 1 GHz operation at 65.1 µW power consumption with 370.4 ps delay and 17.9 mV kickback noise in 0.18 µm CMOS
comments: The grounded reset technique simplifies the circuit but claims must be validated against published StrongARM variants in identical process nodes.

title: An ultra steep slope and low voltage split gate oxide dual gate vertical TFET based multi gas sensor
task: Design ultra steep-slope dual-gate vertical TFET gas sensor for NH₃, O₂, H₂ detection
key_results: Ultra-low OFF-state current ~10⁻¹⁸ A/µm; subthreshold swing 17.5 mV/dec; ON-current sensitivities 0.594 (NH₃), 0.933 (O₂), 0.987 (H₂) at 200 meV work-function variation
comments: BTBT-based sensing is novel but sensitivities are moderate and selectivity via work-function tuning (Co, Ag, Pd) needs experimental cross-sensitivity validation.

title: Four faces of information in natural systems
task: Clarify conceptual foundations and technical meanings of 'information' across scientific disciplines
key_results: Four distinct technical faces of information identified: engineering, statistical, thermodynamic, and ontological; pluralistic perspective advocated over monolithic definition
comments: Perspective is conceptually valuable but does not resolve fundamental tensions between faces—may reinforce disciplinary fragmentation rather than fostering synthesis.
